title: URPX Utility Discovery Manifest
description: Per-utility manifest at ca/<class>/<utility>/utility.toml. Points to where the utility publishes its tariffs so that scrapers can discover unmodeled schedules and detect updates to modeled ones. Distinct from the per-filing tariff.toml: tariff.toml pins a specific snapshot (URL + sha256 + retrieval date), utility.toml points at the discovery surface where future snapshots can be found. Schema is intentionally minimal — richer fields (per-schedule URL patterns, AL-listing URLs, scrape strategy details) can be added once a real scraper is built and tells us what it needs.

utility.description: Short utility identifier matching the directory name (e.g. 'pge', 'cpau').

tariff_index_urls.description: One or more URLs where the utility publishes tariffs. Each URL should be a discovery surface (e.g. a tariff library page, a rate-plans landing page, an advice-letter listing) — not a per-tariff PDF.

scrape_notes.description: Free-text hints about scrape strategy: known TLS-fingerprint blocks (curl_cffi required), URL patterns per schedule, AL-listing locations, paywalls, etc.
